# Ink Whale Leap · 水墨鲸跃
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the web UI whe
n the page loads, then fades out by itself.
中文说明
## What it shows
A full-window overlay in the palette of an ink wash on paper: the whale rises out of the still water
, three ink rings spread from the waterline, a few ink drops scatter upward, and the wordmark `DeepS
eek Harness` settles in with a red `鲸` seal and the line `鲸跃 · 与你同游`.

- 3.95 s after the page loads the overlay fades, and it is removed from the DOM at 4.75 s.
- `Esc` d

ismisses it immediately.
- With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the animations are turned off.
- If
the tab is hidden when the page loads, playback waits for the tab to become visible (15 s fallback)

.
- The overlay is decorative: `aria-hidden="true"`, `pointer-events: none`, so it never takes click
s or keyboard focus.

## Preview without installing
Open `preview.html` in a browser from a checkout of this repository; it loads `splash.js` against a
ew.html` in a browser from a checkout of this repository; it loads `splash.js` against a blank page.
## How it works
This is a host-only plugin. It reacts to `webserver/index-inject` by pushing a single inline `<scrip
t>` row, and serves the animation source at `/ink-whale/splash.js` from the `webServer` service.
There is deliberately no client entry point: in DSH, a client bundle that fails to activate aborts t
he web boot, and a launch animation is not worth that risk. Every step of activation is wrapped in `
try/catch`, so a missing service or a failing injection leaves the app untouched instead of breaking
catch`, so a missing service or a failing injection leaves the app untouched instead of breaking it.
The animation itself is one self-contained IIFE with inline CSS and SVG (`splash.js`) — no network r
equests, no fonts, no images.
## Configuration
None. The plugin has no settings page and no options.
## Uninstall
Remove it the same way as any other plugin (market uninstall, or `dsh plugin remove dsh-ink-whale-le
e it the same way as any other plugin (market uninstall, or `dsh plugin remove dsh-ink-whale-leap`).
## Notes
- The animation runs once per page load, on every window that loads the web UI — it is not a once-pe

r-install welcome screen.
- It only paints over the web UI; the desktop window chrome is unaffected.
